tips: Start a WhatsApp broadcast list the moment a regular buys something — one new number a day grows fast.
Keep your Google Business Profile hours, phone number and item list updated; add photos of stocked shelves weekly.
Announce daily or weekly specials on WhatsApp Status — regulars check it more than you think.
Tie up with nearby offices or societies for monthly bulk orders with home delivery.
Offer a small fixed discount when a customer refers a neighbour who shops with you.
commonMistakes: Paying for ads before your Google listing and WhatsApp list are active.

No updated phone number or timings on Google — people walk away.
